scope_preservation.topic_definition: A Topic is a concrete work matter supported by one or more Sources. Group/conversation membership does not establish Topic identity. A message may support several Topics; an evidence span may have multiple memberships; one Topic may have noncontiguous evidence. Preserve uncertainty and governing conditions, evidence, exceptions, action, approval, and reply scope.

research_questions.RQ1: Which unit preserves a work matter's scope: sentence, clause, arbitrary span, EDU, hybrid? No premature choice without comparative evidence.
research_questions.RQ2: How direct email/asynchronous methods represent clusters and interleaving/non-sequential Topics.
research_questions.RQ3: Multi-topic messages, multiple memberships per span, non-contiguous spans per Topic. Gold capability separate from model predictions.
research_questions.RQ4: Overlapping and discontinuous representations: direct email versus transfer only.
research_questions.RQ5: Errors losing or broadening conditions, evidence, action, approval, reply scope. Directly measured versus plausible risks.
research_questions.RQ6: Distinct metrics, exact dataset/task/denominators: Pk, WindowDiff, pair/cluster scores, span F1/IoU, multi-label metrics, preservation metrics. Numeric source inconsistencies remain visible.
research_questions.RQ7: Datasets, annotation process, IAA, splits, leakage/near duplicates, transfer limitations to business email.
research_questions.RQ8: Minimal evidence-preserving representation/evaluation experiments to investigate next, not architecture approval.

scope_preservation.task_comparison_rule: Never compare scores from these ten tasks as equivalent. Preserve exact dataset, gold/prediction unit, label cardinality, denominator, alignment, and supervision setting.
